questions: How do I place an order?
How can I buy a product?
What are the steps to order something?
faqs.answer: Browse our catalog, click **Add to cart** on the products you want, then open your cart and click **Checkout**. Enter your shipping address, choose a payment method and confirm. You'll receive a confirmation email right away.

questions: How can I track my order?
Where is my package?
How do I know the status of my delivery?
faqs.answer: Go to **My Account → My Orders** and click **Track** next to your order. You'll also find the tracking number in your shipping confirmation email.

questions: Can I cancel my order?
How do I cancel an order I just placed?
faqs.answer: You can cancel an order free of charge as long as it hasn't shipped. Go to **My Orders**, select the order and click **Cancel order**. If it has already shipped, you can return it once it arrives.

questions: Can I change my order after placing it?
How do I modify my order?
Can I add an item to an existing order?
faqs.answer: Orders can be modified within **1 hour** of being placed from **My Orders → Edit**. After that, please contact our support team and we'll do our best to help before it ships.

questions: I did not receive an order confirmation email
Why didn't I get a confirmation email?
faqs.answer: Please check your spam or promotions folder first. If it's not there, make sure the email address in your account is correct. You can always see your order in **My Account → My Orders**.

questions: Is there a minimum order amount?
What is the minimum purchase?
faqs.answer: There is no minimum order amount. However, orders over **$50** qualify for free standard shipping.

questions: How long does shipping take?
When will my order arrive?
What is the delivery time?
faqs.answer: Standard shipping takes **3–5 business days** and express shipping takes **1–2 business days**. Orders placed before 2 PM ship the same day.

questions: How much does shipping cost?
What are the delivery fees?
Is shipping free?
faqs.answer: Standard shipping is **free for orders over $50**, otherwise it costs $4.99. Express shipping costs $9.99 for any order.

questions: Do you ship internationally?
Can you deliver to another country?
Which countries do you ship to?
faqs.answer: Yes, we ship to more than **40 countries**. International delivery takes 7–14 business days and the cost is calculated at checkout. Customs duties may apply depending on your country.

questions: Can I change my shipping address?
I entered the wrong delivery address
faqs.answer: If your order hasn't shipped yet, go to **My Orders → Edit address**. If it has already shipped, contact support and we'll try to redirect it with the carrier.

questions: My package is late
My order has not arrived yet
My delivery is delayed
faqs.answer: Sorry about the delay! First check the tracking link in **My Orders**. If the package hasn't moved for more than 3 business days, contact us and we'll open an investigation with the carrier or send a replacement.

questions: Can I pick up my order in store?
Do you offer store pickup?
faqs.answer: Yes! Choose **Click & Collect** at checkout. Your order will be ready at the selected store within 24 hours and is free of charge.

questions: What is your return policy?
Can I return a product?
How many days do I have to return an item?
faqs.answer: You can return most items within **30 days** of delivery, as long as they are unused and in their original packaging. Returns are free for customers in our main shipping countries.

questions: How do I return an item?
What are the steps to send a product back?
faqs.answer: Go to **My Orders**, select the item and click **Return**. Print the prepaid shipping label, pack the item and drop it off at any partner post office.

questions: When will I get my refund?
How long does a refund take?
I haven't received my refund
faqs.answer: Refunds are issued within **5 business days** after we receive your return. Depending on your bank, it can take another 3–5 days to appear on your statement.

questions: Can I exchange a product for a different size or color?
How do I exchange an item?
faqs.answer: Yes. Start a return in **My Orders** and choose **Exchange** instead of refund, then select the new size or color. We ship the new item as soon as your return is scanned.

questions: I received a damaged item
My product arrived broken
The item I received is defective
faqs.answer: We're sorry! Please contact us within **7 days** with a photo of the damaged item. We'll send a free replacement or a full refund — you won't need to pay for the return.

questions: I received the wrong item
This is not what I ordered
faqs.answer: Sorry for the mix-up! Contact support with your order number and a photo of the item you received. We'll ship the correct item immediately and send you a free return label.

questions: Which items cannot be returned?
Are there products that are not refundable?
faqs.answer: For hygiene reasons, opened cosmetics, underwear and earphones cannot be returned. Gift cards and personalized products are also non-refundable.

questions: What payment methods do you accept?
How can I pay?
Can I pay with PayPal?
faqs.answer: We accept **Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay**. In some countries, cash on delivery is also available.

questions: Is it safe to pay on your website?
Is my payment information secure?
faqs.answer: Yes. All payments are encrypted with SSL and processed by certified payment providers (PCI-DSS). We never store your full card number.

questions: Can I pay in installments?
Do you offer buy now pay later?
faqs.answer: Yes, for orders over $100 you can split your payment into **3 or 4 interest-free installments** by selecting this option at checkout.

questions: My payment was declined
Why did my payment fail?
faqs.answer: Please check your card details and billing address, and make sure your card allows online payments. If it still fails, try another payment method or contact your bank.

questions: I was charged twice
Why do I see two payments for one order?
faqs.answer: Sometimes a temporary authorization appears in addition to the real charge. It disappears automatically within 3–5 days. If both charges remain after that, contact us and we'll refund the duplicate.

questions: How do I use a promo code?
Where do I enter a discount code?
My coupon is not working
faqs.answer: Enter your code in the **Promo code** field on the cart page and click **Apply**. Check that the code hasn't expired and that your cart meets its conditions (minimum amount, eligible products).

questions: Can I get an invoice?
How do I download my receipt?
faqs.answer: Yes. Go to **My Orders**, open the order and click **Download invoice** to get a PDF copy.

questions: How do I create an account?
How can I sign up?
How do I register?
faqs.answer: Click **Sign up** at the top of the page and enter your name, email and a password — or sign up with Google or Apple. It only takes a minute.

questions: I forgot my password
How do I reset my password?
I can't log in to my account
faqs.answer: Click **Log in → Forgot password?** and enter your email. You'll receive a link to create a new password (check your spam folder if you don't see it).

questions: Can I order without an account?
Do I need an account to buy?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can check out as a **guest**. Creating an account lets you track orders, save addresses and earn loyalty points.

questions: How do I delete my account?
I want to close my account
faqs.answer: Go to **My Account → Privacy settings → Delete account**. Your personal data will be erased within 30 days, as required by data protection laws.

questions: How do I update my personal information?
How can I change my email address?
faqs.answer: Go to **My Account → Profile**, edit your name, email, phone number or saved addresses, then click **Save**.

questions: How do I unsubscribe from your newsletter?
Stop sending me promotional emails
faqs.answer: Click **Unsubscribe** at the bottom of any of our emails, or turn off newsletters in **My Account → Notifications**.

questions: How do I know which size to choose?
Is there a size guide?
faqs.answer: Every clothing and shoe page has a **Size guide** link under the size selector, with exact measurements. If you're between two sizes, we recommend choosing the larger one.

questions: When will an out of stock item be available again?
The product I want is sold out
faqs.answer: Click **Notify me** on the product page and we'll email you as soon as it's back in stock. Most items are restocked within 2–3 weeks.

questions: Do your products have a warranty?
What is the warranty period?
faqs.answer: All electronics come with a **2-year manufacturer warranty**. Keep your invoice — you'll need it for any warranty claim.

questions: Are your products authentic?
Do you sell original products?
faqs.answer: Yes, 100%. We buy directly from brands and their official distributors, so every product is guaranteed authentic.

questions: Do you sell gift cards?
How do gift cards work?
faqs.answer: Yes! Gift cards are available from $10 to $500 and are sent by email instantly. They are valid for 12 months and can be used on any product.

questions: Do you have a loyalty program?
How do I earn reward points?
How do loyalty points work?
faqs.answer: Yes — **ShopEase Rewards** is free. You earn 1 point for every $1 spent, and 100 points give you $5 off your next order. Points are added once your order is delivered.

questions: Do you offer student discounts?
Is there a discount for students?
faqs.answer: Yes! Verify your student status in **My Account → Student offer** to get **10% off** all year round.

questions: How can I contact customer service?
How do I talk to a human?
What is your phone number?
faqs.answer: You can reach our team by live chat on the website, by email at **support@shopease.example** or by phone at **+1 800 555 0199**, Monday to Saturday, 9 AM – 6 PM.

questions: What are your opening hours?
When is customer support available?
faqs.answer: Our online store is open 24/7. Customer support is available **Monday to Saturday, 9 AM – 6 PM**.

questions: Where are your stores located?
Do you have physical shops?
faqs.answer: We have 25 stores across the country. Use the **Store locator** at the bottom of our website to find the nearest one and its opening hours.
